title: The shape of light
use: Architecture, access, time passing, looking through a sequence, and quiet editorial transitions.
description: A perspective walk past five mineral-plaster vaults. One raking light moves long shadows over a rectangular promenade while the camera trucks gently across the opening.
copy: Use the corridor as a full-frame insert or inspect the clear ground before placing a native title. Keep type out of the receding vault edges and moving shadows.
